retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: Lets start with an brainstorming idea dump, not everything here works, this is just ideas. I don't want model assistance here, I want to have my unrefined prose stored and flagged as brainstorming.  This is prep for Longmont Campaign 2 Session 21

**Loose threads you may want in your peripheral vision:** Bonogo vs Marla/Stuart/Stacey **not adjudicated**, only **paused by departure**; **Thrin** still on Ephanna’s watch (*dossier:* `NPCs/thrin_branchborn/`); **timeline strangeness** on Lysandra’s side of the call.

**Lysandra** is **with the party again**, physically found at a **half-unpacked wagon** in the wild. She was **under cult-tinted influence** (shimmer eyes); **Caelynn’s tea** broke the surface of it. Lysandra remembers **voices in the dark** after the party entered the forest, **gaps in time**, **meat-smell** while trying to sleep — and she had been **drawing** something she called a **tower** and “where the voices are.” That drawing is still **player knowledge** as a lead, not necessarily literal truth.

Meanwhile, **the Festival of Expansion is still proceeding as planned.** The city leadership has decided to suppress knowledge of the crisis to maintain order. The party’s role in recent events is well known to certain factions but remains a mystery to the general populace.

The **city of Mirathorn** has survived a catastrophic cultist plot. The **Shepherd’s Flock** attempted to summon an **Abyssal Flesh Kaiju** beneath the city by feeding corrupted human cultists into a ritual pit. The party **disrupted the summoning**, defeated the cult leaders, and destroyed the pre-Kaiju entity. However, the **Shepherd** still exists, and remnants of the cult remain.

They continue on north with Karsemine and Caelynn keeping an eye out for high ground for a place to stop for the night. While on this short trip everyone is able to relax and have a short rest. Because of their timing leaving the town and their navigation skills, the wagon is able to make it far enough north to just hit the very edge of the storm and only get soaked. They are able to see the sheen of magic as the rain pools up and instead of the usual petrichor the rain smells savory. Karsemine and Caelynn spot a good camping spot on the top of a conical hill. They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove

retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: After another failed attempt to contact Mirathorn by rockie-talkie, the group decides they need to come up with a plan to contact someone in the city they can trust.[Location][Elderwyld/Cities and Towns/Mirathorn/][Party][Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Parties/questionable_company/] After some debate, they decide they should send a message to Professor Tealeaf, assuming the Wizard’s College is the least likely to be affected by anything nefarious happening, and an encoded message to Grobnok in case the message gets intercepted.[NPC][Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/NPCs/sara_mirathorn_operator/] The group decides on a spoken and written message about the problems they have had contacting the city

retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: The group continues on when they see a cloud of dust as something is moving fast in their direction. They soon encounter a young rider on a horse at top speed. She slows long enough to say that they cannot stop unless they have food for her horse so that she can continue on. The horse has clearly been running at full speed for a long time and could use a short break. Caeylynn conjures some Good Berries for the horse and fetches some water. Stafl immediately recognizes the soldier’s uniform of the Elderwild Reach, the same uniform he wore before leaving and joining this group. The woman introduces herself as Private Hester and she is carrying a sealed tube in her hand with reports for Miratho
